description: 광주교통공사_역사별출구연계버스현황 [railways and stations and bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 광주교통공사. 이 데이터는 광주광역시 도시철도공사 역사 출구별 연계 버스 현황을 정리한 자료로, 각 지하철 역 출구에서 이용 가능한 버스 노선과 해당 버스의 주요 행선지를 제공합니다. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
